title: Corr edit sidecar
description: Sidecar next to a media file (MyMovie.mkv → MyMovie.corr.json). Playback applies mute, zoom, blur, and skip. Other actions are reserved. Non-length-altering edits (mute, zoom, blur) are applied before length-altering edits (skip/cut, and later crop). All times are on the original source timeline and are never adjusted for cuts or crops.

runtime.description: Original source runtime in seconds (not the edited duration).

start.description: Range start in seconds on the original source timeline. Never adjusted for cuts, crops, or other length-changing edits.

end.description: Range end in seconds on the original source timeline; must be greater than start. Never adjusted for cuts, crops, or other length-changing edits.

action.description: Playback applies "mute", "zoom" (alias "punch"), "blur" (alias "boxblur"), and "skip". Other values are ignored until supported.

scale.description: Zoom factor (> 1). Default 2. Ignored when box is set for zoom.

x.description: Zoom center X at range start, 0–1. Default 0.5.

y.description: Zoom center Y at range start, 0–1. Default 0.5.

x_end.description: Zoom center X at range end. Linear pan from x. Omit for a static zoom.

y_end.description: Zoom center Y at range end. Linear pan from y. Omit for a static zoom.

radius.description: Boxblur luma radius in pixels (single pass; power is not configurable). Default 8. Clamped per plane so luma cannot exceed half the region and chroma cannot exceed half the subsampled chroma size.

box.description: Normalized region at range start. For zoom: crop this box and scale it to fill the frame. For blur: blur only this region (omit for full-frame blur).

width.description: Width, 0–1. Omit to keep box width.

height.description: Height, 0–1. Omit to keep box height.

box_end.description: Normalized region at range end. X/Y lerp from box on the original timeline (pan). Width/height stay at the start box because FFmpeg crop size is not per-frame.
